digest.component_or_area: MCP server config ownership seam enforcement
propositions: Ambient config and credential reads in mcp_server.py and _mcp_auth.py must be routed through approved composition-root seam resolvers instead of reading below-seam
Three new owned composition-root resolvers (mcp_gate, compose_config, read_secret_env) must be added to config.py to enable seam-compliant config/secret resolution
MCP LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS entries must be removed from scripts/config_ownership_exceptions.py and check_config_ownership.py must report zero violations
Per-request config resolution semantics must be preserved with no behavioral delta; secret values remain in-memory only and fail-closed on unset
All MCP behavioral test suites (tests/interfaces/facades, tests/unit MCP/auth) must remain green and unmodified after cutover
